ELECTRICITY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Assembly Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Assembly Drawing.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Assembly Drawing.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Assembly Drawing.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Assembly Drawing.

2. When learning Direct Current Motors, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Direct Current Motors.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Direct Current Motors.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Direct Current Motors.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Direct Current Motors.

3. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

4. When learning Fabrication Techniques, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fabrication Techniques.

5. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. International Cricket Team

6. When learning Single-Phase alternating current Transformers, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Single-Phase alternating current Transformers.

   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single phase Alternating Current Motors.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single phase Alternating Current Motors.

8. When learning Lamps and Lamp Circuits, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Lamps and Lamp Circuits.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Lamps and Lamp Circuits.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Lamps and Lamp Circuits.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Lamps and Lamp Circuits.

9. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Monitor
   C. Keyboard
   D. Speaker

10. When learning Solar Photovoltaic Installation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Solar Photovoltaic Installation.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Solar Photovoltaic Installation.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Solar Photovoltaic Installation.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Solar Photovoltaic Installation.

11. When learning Combinational Logic Circuits, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Combinational Logic Circuits.

   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Combinational Logic Circuits.

12. When learning Computer Aided Drafting and Design, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drafting and Design.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Aided Drafting and Design.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Aided Drafting and Design.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Computer Aided Drafting and Design.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Combinational Logic Circuits and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Home- based Automatic Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Project Implementation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Assembly Drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
